node.title: SOV forced-root recursion algebra
node.statement: For every h over odd characteristic, the monic degree-h square-root recursion uniquely recovers the degree-h polynomial S forced by the top h+1 coefficients of a monic degree-2h locator L, and the obstruction vector is exactly the list of coefficients of S^2-L in degrees 1 through h-1. In the X79 shifted-constant trade model the recursion returns the midpoint and all obstructions vanish.
node.attack_surface: symbolic triangular coefficient recursion; local verifier replays the generalized X79 gate for several h
node.falsifier: a degree 2h locator whose top coefficients do not determine the forced root by the printed recursion, or a shifted-constant X79 trade with a nonzero obstruction
